name: perf-start
js: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await sleep(2500);const ts=[];let last=performance.now();const t0=last;await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){const n=performance.now();ts.push(n-last);last=n;if(n-t0<6000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});ts.sort((a,b)=>a-b);const m=ts.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/ts.length;const mem=performance.memory?Math.round(performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize/1048576):null;console.log('[perf] perf-start mean '+m.toFixed(2)+' ms median '+ts[ts.length>>1].toFixed(2)+' p95 '+ts[Math.floor(ts.length*0.95)].toFixed(2)+' n '+ts.length+' readyAt '+window.__mapScaleReadyAt+' heapMB '+mem+' res '+performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e=>/toronto-|bike-share-stations/.test(e.name)).reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.transferSize||0),0))})()
